inspection_metadata.measurement_resolution: 0.5 mm or finer at critical points

camera_fit.working_orientation_description: Camera X dimension (depth) along frame Y axis; camera Y dimension (width) along frame X (depth) axis; camera Z along frame Z (vertical)
camera_fit.limiting_factor: Frame Y (lateral) width at bridge is only ~3mm
camera_fit.recommendation: Either redesign bridge to widen to ≥9mm Y, or orient camera with Y axis through the depth direction

candidate_positions_per_lens: Top-inner corner near bridge (Z=30, inner side)
Side-inner (mid-height inner rim - requires rim thickening)
led_pockets.recommendation: Outer rim corners and middle are feasible for LED placement with proper orientation. LED must be oriented with its depth (1.5mm + clearance) along frame Y (lateral) and its width (3.4mm + clearance) along frame Z (vertical) or X (depth).

inner_rim_mid.reason: Only 3.3mm wide; cannot fit 3.5mm channel + walls

inner_rim_top.reason: Only 3.3-3.7mm wide; YELLOW only at very top corners

nose_bridge.reason: Y width is only ~3mm; cannot accommodate 3.5mm channel

must_change_dimensions: Inner rim needs ~1.0mm additional material on inner side to widen
Nose bridge needs to be widened by ~2mm or redesigned to be wider/flatter
Outer rim corners can accommodate without modification
pcb_channel_feasibility.channel_path_alternative: Route channel on the OUTER side of the rim only, avoiding inner side

mechanical_constraints.tightest_dimension: Inner rim Y width = 3.3mm (only 0.1mm margin to fit PCB channel width)
mechanical_constraints.tightest_location: Z=20-28 mid-height of inner rims of both lenses
mechanical_constraints.bridge_constraint: Bridge Y width of 3mm cannot accommodate the 3.5mm channel width

risks: Bridge is too narrow (~3mm Y) for 8.5x8.5x6.5 camera. Camera redesign required.
Inner rim width (3.3mm) is just below 3.5mm channel requirement.
Front face is at X=156.8; the rim curves backward, reducing usable depth near lens openings.
Triangulated STL conversion adds ±0.05mm uncertainty; critical fits require ±0.1mm tolerance.
Wayfarer geometry has a strong taper toward the bottom (Z<10), reducing usable material at lens bottom corners.

LOW: exact camera envelope (binary search not run due to avoid isInside patterns)
